volume_touch.action: one tap, one step, same path as the HAT Vol- and Vol+ buttons
volume_touch.sensor: TTP223, momentary, active-low, powered at 3.3 V
volume_touch.wiring: output across the existing button contact after that contact is confirmed active-low to ground

mic_mute.face: bottom edge, between the volume pads
mic_mute.type: latching switch, dry contact across the HAT hardware mute

status_leds.place: under the cloth, lower front edge of the bay
status_leds.part: discrete 3 mm LED behind the hole, one 1 kohm resistor each
status_leds.wiring: Cathode to ground. Anode through 1 kohm. White anode from the HAT 3.3 V rail. Blue, red and amber each go to a free Core header tail that protrudes through the HAT.
status_leds.do_not_use: GPIO21 is the ring data line. GPIO45 is the ESP32 strapping LED.

lamps.drive: own Core GPIO, not yet assigned
own Core GPIO, not yet assigned
own Core GPIO, not yet assigned

cloth_fastening.style: flush with the frame edge, front rabbet

magnet.fix: glued in the front rabbet, opening toward the cloth

amplifier.part: stereo analog Class-D, line input, 12 to 26 V, 4 ohm and 8 ohm
amplifier.reason: Satellite1 public firmware routes I2S GPIO9 to the onboard DAC proxy. External sound is the PCM5122 jack.

electronics.power: One internal Mean Well IRM-30-24. Its 24 V rail feeds the amplifier and, through a USB-C PD source, the HAT.

mains_inlet.place: rear skin, beside the IRM-30 AC pins

cable_pass.place: divider, right side, into the space behind the panel
cable_pass.use: two speaker pairs from the amplifier; seal around them
